verdict.rationale: Skills are plain directories (a `SKILL.md` plus optional scripts and references) that land on disk under `.agents/skills`, so an engineering lead can read every installed file afterward. A hands-on install confirmed the skill arrived as a readable `SKILL.md` file. Before installing, review depends on the public catalog (which lists source paths) and on the skills' GitHub directories, not on a documented preview feature in the installer. missing for 10: a documented pre-install content listing or diff in `$skill-installer` or the plugin browser, an explicit way to show which scripts a skill will add, and independent corroboration of the review workflow.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can review exactly what instructions and scripts a skill will add — list contents before installing and read every file afterward
